source.name: SADIE II Database V2.2, D1 KU100

azimuthConvention: target and source positive azimuth = left (counter-clockwise, ADM/ITU)

processing.directPathModel: target HRIR plus calibrated BRIR room tail
processing.note: One KU100 room/listening position. Per-speaker common arrival, direct reference level, low-resolution room-response correction, and deterministic decorrelation only for reused BRIR room tails; no layout- or programme-specific EQ.

roomCorrection.target: robust median BRIR/paired-HRIR room transfer across all virtual speakers

roomTailDecorrelation.scope: only non-canonical virtual speakers that reuse the same measured BRIR source
